boltz2_affinityboltz2_affinity@*
completed

Boltz-2 affinity

Boltz-2 jointly predicts the 3D complex and a binding-affinity score from sequence + ligand input, optionally guided by an MSA. The cards summarise the affinity, binary binding probability, and confidence head. The PAE artifact below contains the per-token pair-error matrix.

Predicted affinity (pIC50)

Boltz-2 predicted pIC50. Higher = tighter. Calibrated only when the target/ligand pair is within training distribution.

Binary binding probability

Probability the predicted complex binds at experimentally relevant concentrations.

Model confidence

Aggregate Boltz-2 confidence (akin to AlphaFold's confidence head).

Seeds used: 42

Protenix structure prediction

Protenix v2 is an AlphaFold-3-class structure predictor for protein / complex inputs. The cards show the top-ranked prediction's confidence heads; the table breaks the result out per sampling seed.
